integrity: Proof derives all strict stability, discriminant, and optimizing inequalities; symbolic/finite-parameter verifier is supplementary; no independent validation claimed.
limitations: Scalar negative-real test equation, two-periodic strictly positive steps, exact arithmetic; optimizes asymptotic two-step spectral radius only. Large imbalance and double Floquet roots can magnify transient errors and do not imply finite-time accuracy.
title: A sharp fixed-budget Floquet optimizer for two-periodic variable-step BDF2
